text:
Rain garden report

A rain garden is a shallow planted area that collects water from roofs and paved surfaces. Its soil and vegetation help water soak into the ground instead of rushing into storm drains.

I planted three shrubs beside the old shed last April. The smallest one survived because my neighbor watered it whenever I was away, and the bare patch has finally turned green.
